# vcop2: seeds for the SCSP sound board's 68000 (m2sndrecomp --scsp).
# Addresses only, our own analysis (rules.md rule 7). Four computed jumps, each
# "lea (d,PC,Dn),An; jmp (An)" into a table of 4-byte jmp/bra entries right after
# it; every entry is a seed: 0x601b80 (16, from 0x601b7c), 0x6036d6 (16, 0x6036d4),
# 0x603eb0 (16, 0x603eae), 0x60484c (8, 0x604848), 0x602b3c (81: D2 < 0x51,
# 0x602b38), 0x603728 (16: D0 <= 15, 0x603726).
